value.text:
The memo CRUD mutations and queries reside in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`.

It uses `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect`. That client is created in `web/src/connect.ts` from `./types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb`.

q17. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

That module defines the memo CRUD React Query hooks (`useMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, etc.) and imports the generated Connect client from `@/connect`:

```5:5:web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
import { memoServiceClient } from "@/connect";
```

`memoServiceClient` is created in `web/src/connect.ts` from the generated `MemoService` protobuf definition:

```197:197:web/src/connect.ts
export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);
```
